name: triceps-extension-dumbbell-seated-two-arm
title: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Seated, Two Arm)
primer: This exercise is the two handed version of seated triceps extension.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring your arms up to your sides so the dumbbells are almost parallel to your chest, keeping your lower arms vertical.
Press your arms back in an arc towards your back.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
